storefront.code_hidden: No code is shown: only coupons without a customer restriction show their code on the site.
storefront.help: The campaign's card on the branded site. Dates and the coupon code come from the campaign itself; here you set visibility, order, texts and the image. Changes appear on the site within about 30 seconds.
storefront.image_hint: Chosen from the site media library. Without an image, a gradient of the theme colors is used.
storefront.image_no_access: Choosing an image requires permission to view the branded site.
storefront.load_failed: The website card could not be loaded.
storefront.note_channel: Web is not among the campaign's sales channels; it does not appear on the site until the web channel is added.
storefront.note_inactive: The campaign is not active right now; it appears on the site while it is active and within its dates.
storefront.section_texts_hint: Plain text. Empty English fields show the Turkish text.
storefront.show_on_site_hint: When on, the campaign is listed in the home page's offers section and on /campaigns.
storefront.site_cta_hint: Leave empty to use the site's default button label.
storefront.site_sort_hint: Lower numbers come first; ties keep the order they were added in.
storefront.sort_invalid: Enter a whole number between -100000 and 100000.

storefront.title_required: A campaign shown on the site needs at least one title.
